speaker: alse_pinder
text: The loaf is two fingers short of the notch. I paid the penny.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Two fingers, and a penny. We are not paying tuppence to feel virtuous.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A penny. I will not argue with a stall before church.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then do not argue with it after. Monday is your supper. Today is the pot, and the pot is ordinary.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Monday at six, at the Bell. Nothing is paid today. I am not carrying the brief to church.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The cloak is by the door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am coming. The garret can wait until the sand is out.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The sand will be out whether you are in the pew or on the stair. Come.
